integrity: The standard boundary is obtained by two exhaustive traversal directions and two independent Coombs implementations with exact event-set equality. The exactly-two-abstainer boundary is separately exhausted through thirteen voters, and every candidate-relabeling class is checked directly.
scientific_limitations: The classification is complete only for three candidates with strict complete anonymous ballots and tie-independent unique outcomes. The exactly-two-abstainer boundary is a restricted variant distinct from standard participation.
title: Sharp no-show boundary for three-candidate Coombs voting
